release: Zenonia 2 DS Runner - DS Fat minimap fix 1

actions.open_or_select: No game directory creation or replacement
actions.Check Error: Validate translation only; on error write error.txt in --home (default: beside the tool). No game output changes.
actions.Create Game Folder: Apply the selected translation or copy original KR resources to zenonia2nds/. Translated resources are validated before commit.
actions.KR: Original resource files; no translation validation. Optional offline compatibility profile remains separate.
actions.error_log: Reports resource names and validation errors. A successful translation check removes the previous tool-generated error.txt.

tested.fixture: User-provided native ARM WIPI ZIP/JAR; not bundled
tested.host_runner_tests: Source/header checks, external filesystem reads and path guards, repaint/minimap/cache/graphics regression suite passed. Hardware access not emulated.
tested.browser: Real local UI tested: separate actions, no automatic export, invalid TXT errors written to file, no output changes on check, corrected TXT succeeds, KR validation disabled, original KR exported. No JS errors.
tested.visual: Desktop success/error and narrow KR layouts rendered and individually inspected.

not_tested: This minimap-fix build on DS Fat/R4 or DSi hardware

minimap_fix.cache_expiry: Measured from the completion of native capture; not its start
minimap_fix.tradeoff: Lower minimap/marker refresh frequency; game/audio scheduling unchanged
minimap_fix.diagnostics: LOG rows 15-17: max native/panel ms, hit/draw counts, interval/fallback count
tests: Actual runtime cache glue tested with a simulated 180 ms native draw
Policy: expiry boundary, wraparound, invalid capture, map/object/geometry changes, DS/DSi intervals
Pixel comparison against frozen renderer: 6900 regular sizes plus 2000 large/tall cases
Repaint gate, 40000 randomized blits, RGB565 conversion, callback/cache guards, external-file backend and guarded native wrapper tests passed
